results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: Article highlighting a study led by Fabio Giglietto on Meta's political content reduction policy, showing how social media recommendation algorithms penalize elected officials' visibility while inadvertently boosting extreme content.
